hublot

Add a machine

On the machine you want to control, open hublot and click share this PC. It shows you its address. Type that here, and approve the request when it appears there.

It's a Proxmox or Linux console

A text console has no screen to ask on, so it pairs the old way: run host-agent --pairing there and paste what it prints.

Let another hublot control this PC

Start the agent here, then type this machine's address into the panel on the other computer. A request will appear on this screen and you approve it — nothing to copy.

This machine's address

Type this into the other computer's mirror tab.

What the other computer gets

Everything on this screen, this keyboard and this mouse, and the clipboard in both directions. Approve a request only if the six digits match what its panel is showing — that is what proves nothing is sitting in between.

Summon hotkey

Click the field and press the combination you want.

Proxmox console (shell tab)

Mirror targets

Any machine running the host agent — the Proxmox host, or a VM on it.

Unlock the console

Stored in Windows Credential Manager, sealed with DPAPI. It never reaches this window again — the console socket lives in the Rust process.
